tasks.short: Provide logistics technology or information for effective and efficient support of product, equipment, or system manufacturing or service.

steps.what: Pull product and equipment records for the support request.
List installed logistics technology against the equipment.
Watch the manufacturing or service step the technology should support.
Judge which logistics technology gives effective support.
Check the support note against the watched step.
File the support note for the equipment owner.

tasks.design: Installed technology is listed from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The analyst watches the manufacturing or service step and judges what gives effective support. {PROJECT} receives the note only after that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support notes were written from an equipment list without watching the step.
tasks.enabler_now: The equipment record can be opened before anyone goes to the floor.
tasks.still_hard: A technology that is installed is not the same as a technology that supports the step.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst sees the delay, the reach, and the workaround the list does not show.
tasks.altitude: The analyst still watches the step and chooses the support. Listing what is already installed does not stay as desk work.

reach.task: Use the support note on the line
reach.learn: Which step was watched and which technology was rejected

evidence.claim: A list of installed equipment can be read from a system of record. Whether it supports a manufacturing step is a watch.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from a support request and a watch to a filed note. Buying the technology is out of scope.
Test the existing {ERP} or {OPS_SYSTEM} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are equipment id, site, and the step watched. Fallback: a step with no watch note is marked not seen.
EU data-protection rules apply. A feed that names a person is monitoring and needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
The prior class is amplify. The record match is that gain. The support judgement is not, because the hard part is what the step actually needs.
unknowns: Whether the manufacturing or service step can be watched before the note is due.
research_questions: How often the watch rejects the technology the installed list suggested.

incremental.description: Keep equipment identifiers aligned with the sites in scope

approvals.approved_version: support note checked against the watched step

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The record pull and the filing are saved. The watch and the support judgement stay. The low case is a manufacturing step the analyst has not watched.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate effectiveness of current or future logistical processes.

steps.what: Collect current process times from the operations log.
Compare current cycle times with the stated target.
Evaluate whether current logistical processes are effective.
State whether a future process change is worth a trial.

tasks.design: Cycle times are compared with the target in {BI}. The analyst evaluates whether the current process is effective and whether a future change is worth a trial. Nothing is sent onward.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effectiveness was a colour on a chart, with no one saying what the gap meant.
tasks.enabler_now: Cycle times already sit in the operations log.
tasks.still_hard: A missed target is not by itself an ineffective process.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which delay the site can actually remove.
tasks.altitude: The analyst still evaluates the process and decides on a trial. The time comparison does not.

reach.learn: Which gap was judged real and which was a bad target

evidence.claim: Cycle times can be compared with a target. Calling a process effective is a judgement.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from logged times to a trial decision. Changing the process is out of scope.
Test the existing {ERP} or {OPS_SYSTEM} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are process id, cycle time, and the target the site stated. Fallback: a process with no target is marked not comparable.
EU data-protection rules apply. A feed that names a person is monitoring and needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
The prior class is amplify. Only the comparison is. Evaluating effectiveness stays, because a gap is not a verdict.
unknowns: What this site treats as an effective process.
research_questions: How often a missed target is left as a bad target rather than a process change.

incremental.description: Retire targets the site no longer uses

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The time comparison is saved. The effectiveness judgement stays. The low case is a process with no reliable cycle time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct the work of logistics analysts.

steps.what: Read each analyst's open logistics assignments.
Direct logistics analysts on the week's assignments.
Hear what blocked the analysts and reset the order.

tasks.design: The open list is read from {PROJECT}. Directing the analysts and hearing what blocked them stay a meeting. No message is sent for them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction was a shared sheet that nobody stood behind.
tasks.enabler_now: The assignment board can be opened before the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: People do not take direction from a sorted list.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst hears the blocker and changes the order in the room.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the meeting. Preparing the open list is the only part that shrinks.

reach.learn: Which assignment was reset and why

evidence.claim: An assignment list can be opened from a project board. Directing analysts is a conversation.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from the open board to directions given in the meeting. Doing the analysts' own tasks is out of scope.
Test the existing {ERP} or {OPS_SYSTEM} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are analyst name, assignment id, and due date. Fallback: an assignment with no owner is read out, not auto-assigned.
EU data-protection rules apply. A feed that names a person is monitoring and needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
The prior class is human. The graph agrees. Directing is not a status board.
unknowns: How many analysts one person directs in a week.
research_questions: How often the meeting resets an assignment the board had ordered first.

already_counted.description: Directing the analysts in the meeting

incremental.description: Keep the assignment board limited to live work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the assignment list is prepared ahead. Directing the analysts and hearing blockers stay. The low case is a week when every assignment is disputed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate positioning and identification technologies for transportation efficiency.

steps.what: Read the transportation lanes the technologies would cover.
Match lane identifiers to devices already on the vehicles.
Ride one lane and watch the satellite or radio device in use.
Sum on-time arrivals for lanes that already carry a device.
Evaluate radio identification and positioning on one transportation lane.
Check that the evaluation does not score named drivers.
File the technology evaluation for the transport lead.

tasks.design: Device presence and lane arrival totals come from {OPS_SYSTEM} and {BI}. The analyst rides one lane, evaluates the technology, and checks that the note does not score a named driver. The file step waits for that check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technology notes repeated a vendor claim and never rode the lane.
tasks.enabler_now: Lane identifiers and device presence can be matched before the ride.
tasks.still_hard: An arrival total does not show whether the driver could use the device.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst sees the dead spot, the ignored screen, and the workaround.
tasks.altitude: The ride and the evaluation stay. Matching devices and summing arrivals do not.

reach.task: Keep or drop the device on that lane
reach.learn: Which lane was ridden and whether any driver was named

evidence.claim: Lane arrival totals can be summed. A ride is how the analyst sees whether a device is used.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from lanes and one ride to a filed evaluation. Fitting devices and scoring drivers are out of scope.
Test the existing {ERP} or {OPS_SYSTEM} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are lane id, device present or not, and on-time arrival for the lane. Fallback: a lane with no ride is marked not seen. Totals stay at lane level.
EU data-protection rules apply. A feed that names a person is monitoring and needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
The prior class is amplify. The match and the sum are that gain. The evaluation stays with the analyst. A feed that names a driver is not used.
unknowns: Whether the device log identifies a driver or only a vehicle and a lane.
research_questions: How often the ride contradicts the arrival total.

already_counted.description: Evaluating the technology after the ride

incremental.description: Drop device rows that name a person before any total is built

approvals.approved_version: technology evaluation that does not score named drivers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Lane matching and the arrival sum are saved. The ride and the evaluation stay. The low case is a device log that names a driver, which is not used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Rides, process judgements and directing analysts stay. Lists of equipment, times and devices do not.
reach: Transport leads, on whether a device note names a person.
Manufacturing supervisors, on which step was actually watched.
skills_to_grow: Leaving a lane blank when it was not ridden.
Refusing a total that is built from named drivers.
role.ambitious_version: A technology note names the lane ridden, the device watched, and the person who may change it.
